title: IBM i 7.6, 7.5, 7.4, and 7.3 could allow an authenticated user to indirectly disable system auditing, which they…
description: IBM i versions 7.6, 7.5, 7.4, and 7.3 contain a vulnerability where an authenticated user with limited privileges could indirectly disable system auditing, a capability they should not have. This flaw could impact the integrity and availability of system auditing functions.
